name: Omarchy
description: Follows your Omarchy theme: app, editor syntax and terminal colors, updated on every theme switch.

settings.title: Follow the Omarchy theme
settings.description: Applies the current Omarchy theme and follows every switch. When off, Orca keeps whatever theme you pick.

settings.title: Light or dark
settings.description: How Orca classifies the theme. Automatic reads it from the Omarchy theme.

settings.title: Sidebars
settings.description: Projects, worktrees and host badge. When off, Orca derives these from the base colors.

settings.title: Tabs and dividers
settings.description: Tab bar, active tab and pane dividers.

settings.title: Chat
settings.description: User messages, inline code, code blocks and selection.

settings.title: Git decorations
settings.description: Colors for new, modified, deleted and ignored files in the tree.

settings.title: Editor syntax
settings.description: Syntax colors from Omarchy's VS Code theme. When off, the editor uses Orca's default syntax.

settings.title: Terminal ANSI palette
settings.description: The 16 terminal colors. When off, only background, text, cursor and selection follow Omarchy.
